title: Villager shoots a silver-suited hovering assailant with a shotgun

tellings.quote: And he said, "I shot him at point blank range with a shotgun." And it and the blast the shotgun, he could hear the the the BB's dink off the armor and it knocked the guy back on his butt.

plain: In 2023, in the Alto Nanay region of the Peruvian Amazon, a villager says he was attacked by a figure in a silver suit that hovered in the air, and he shot it with a shotgun. The researcher and filmmaker Tim Alberino passes on what the man told him: "I shot him at point blank range with a shotgun," and the man said he heard the pellets ping off armor as the blast knocked the figure onto its backside. If true, it would mean the attackers wore something like armor that could stop gunfire.
